name: mixed — everything lesson 35 proved, plus the scans
comment: The closing scene of the point-cloud series, and the only one that exercises BOTH load paths at once. Everything except the two scans goes through the whole-file prost path (fetch, decode, walk into the shared tables, upload) and stays a kernel object; the two scans go through the Range-streaming path and never become kernel objects at all. The order below deliberately INTERLEAVES them - sheet, scan, sheets, scan, boxes, model - so the two paths take turns and nothing is allowed to depend on running first or last. The four sheets keep 35's planar-lane torture test: flat / standing / tilted / in-plane-spun, xform column-major with translation in slots 12-14. colors_widths is the pen test (3 boxes with per-face colours and edges, 1 polyline, 1 point) and must still draw px-constant pens next to a 3D model. Sheets sit at y=-30000 because each scan spans about 72 m; the scans are 90 m apart along x. Press F: the fit must frame ALL of it.
